Principal Investigator, DST-SERB Project, Department of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of  edical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following item. The tenders in sealed  envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of  Department of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 42102” latest by
10/02/2018 up to 1.00 PM.
The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 12/02/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Department of Biochemistry, MGIMS.
Tender forms will be available in the Department of Biochemistry on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to
kalyangoswami@mgims.ac.in
’
or can be downloaded from the institute website (
www.mgims.ac.in
).
The Principal Investigator, DST-SERB Project reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.

paragraphs: Principal Investigator, DST-SERB Project, Department of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of edical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following item. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of Department of Biochemistry, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 42102” latest by 10/02/2018 up to 1.00 PM. The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 12/02/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Department of Biochemistry, MGIMS.

Tender forms will be available in the Department of Biochemistry on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to kalyangoswami@mgims.ac.in’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Principal Investigator, DST-SERB Project reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
